recipes.name: Australian Meat Pies
ingredients_raw: 0.25 teaspoon ground pepper, or to taste
1 (15 ounce) package refrigerated pie crusts for a double-crust pie

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Grease a 12-cup muffin tin.

Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground beef and onion; cook and stir until meat is browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and discard grease. Add ¾ cup water, ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, bouillon cubes, oregano, and black pepper. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer until combined, about 10 minutes.
Whisk cornstarch and remaining ¼ cup water together in a bowl to form a paste; stir into meat mixture. Cook until thickened, about 5 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Cut pie dough into 12 circles using a 4-inch biscuit cutter. Line each prepared muffin cup with a pie dough circle, pressing into the bottom and up sides of cups. Fill each cup with meat mixture.
Cut puff pastry dough into 12 circles using a 3-inch biscuit cutter. Top each filled muffin cup with a puff pastry circle; seal edges together. Brush puff pastry tops with beaten egg.
Bake in the preheated oven until crusts are brown and flaky, 15 to 20 minutes. Cool pies in the muffin tin before removing, about 10 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Australian Meat Pies
raw_recipe.description: Bake up this recipe for Australia's national food: Australian meat pies filled with browned beef and onion and seasoned with Worcestershire sauce.
